items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 21:17 Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
items.claim: Persons of Aaron's priestly seed with blemishes are prohibited from approaching to offer the bread of their God.
items.actor: the LORD, Moses, Aaron, Whosoever he be of thy seed
items.action: let him not approach to offer
